Certified Welder (Juru Las) Regulations in Indonesia: Class 1, 2 & 3 Certification

Statutory qualification framework for structural steelwork, pressure vessel fabrication, and industrial piping under Indonesian law: welder classes, non-destructive testing (NDT), and WPS/PQR validation.

Permenaker 02/1982 Statutory welding safety law
Class 1, 2, 3 Tiers High pressure to non-load structures
Kemnaker Welder License Statutory 3-year certification card
Statutory Qualification

The Three Statutory Welder Classes Explained

Under Minister of Manpower Regulation No. 02/MEN/1982, any welding performed on pressure vessels, steam boilers, lifting equipment, or load-bearing steel structures must be executed exclusively by a certified Juru Las holding an active license issued by Kemnaker:

Welder Class Permitted Welding Scope Testing Positions Qualified Target Engineering Sector
Kelas 1 (Class I) High-pressure vessels, steam boilers, high-pressure hydrocarbon piping, all critical joints All positions: 1G, 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, 6G / 6GR Oil & Gas, Power Plants, Petrochemical Refineries
Kelas 2 (Class II) Medium pressure vessels, storage tanks, building structural steelwork Plate & pipe in flat, horizontal, and vertical: 1G, 2G, 3G EPC Infrastructure, Smelter Steel Construction
Kelas 3 (Class III) Non-critical structural joints, non-pressurized tanks, general steel framing Flat and horizontal positions: 1G, 2G General Manufacturing, Warehousing Fabrication
